notes: carried from gpu-2026-09-03; gpu-2026-09-20 did not rerun stress
stress.duration; required 600; a load short enough to end before the cards settle cannot establish stability
stress.no_thermal_throttle; required none; a power throttle at the stock cap is expected and is evidence the result is not heat-limited; a thermal throttle is not
stress.occupancy; required 95.0; lowest engine occupancy on any card; proves the load was actually applied rather than assumed
stress.steady_state_clock; required 1.0; clock has stopped drooping
stress.steady_state_power; required 1.0; power draw has flattened
stress.steady_state_temp; required 0.5; package temperature has stopped climbing
stress.window_samples; required 20; samples inside the trailing 180s window; too few and the slope is noise
